description: This file defines an interface `IStateMachineStorage` which provides asynchronous methods for managing state machine logs, including reading, replacing, appending, deleting logs, and checking if a snapshot is requested.

classes.name: IStateMachineStorage
classes.description: Interface providing storage operations for state machines, including methods for reading, replacing, appending, and deleting log segments, as well as a property for snapshot requests.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous, ordered collection of all log segments for this state machine instance.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Replaces the log atomically with the provided value.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the state machine's log atomically.

methods.name: IsCompactionRequested
methods.description: Indicates whether the state machine has requested a snapshot.
